title: Replication Package: Pre-Consent Web Tracking, Cross-Border Flows, and Policy Disclosure in Vietnam (First-Year PDPL Baseline)
description: Replication package accompanying the manuscript Pre-Consent Web Tracking, Cross-Border Flows, and Policy Disclosure in Vietnam: A First-Year PDPL Measurement Baseline (submitted to Journal of Cybersecurity and Privacy, MDPI). Contains deterministic sampling, Playwright crawling, dual-profile identifier attribution (strict 3P + verified 1P-to-3P cookie syncing), sensitivity and clustering scripts, 36.5-hour Wave 2 test-retest reliability analysis (n = 107 paired sites), Official Gazette legal codebook for Law No. 91/2025/QH15 (PDPL) and Decree No. 356/2025/ND-CP, 121-entity corporate domicile registry (95.1% flow coverage), pseudonymised per-site feature datasets (Wave 1 n = 997; Wave 2 n = 150), exhaustive positive-hit verification report, seeded stratified validation templates, and SHA-256 verification manifests. Full raw privacy-policy texts and screenshots are excluded for copyright and privacy protection, and audited website domains are pseudonymised.
